limitations: The detector was trained on the same recording groups; no independent test split exists, so detections are not an accuracy estimate.
The v15 schema has no player class, so player lane, jumping and rolling are unavailable and remain at schema defaults.
No coin class is available; coin features remain absent.
Lane and distance are image geometry; distance is an uncalibrated bottom-edge proxy, not metres.
Spikes are model output from a fixed connectome with no plasticity. They are not measured biological activity and no action is selected.
One mapping realization and one seed are used.
